name.ja: SD三国伝 031 真 典韋アッシマー・賈クアシュタロン 攻城兵器セット
name.en: SD Sangokuden 031 Shin Dianwei Assimer/Jia Quastalon Siege Weapon Set

description.ja: • ボリューム満点、ギミック満載の超豪華セット。
description.en: • A super luxurious set full of volume and full of gimmicks.

description.ja: • 典韋アッシマーは、大斧形態に変形。
description.en: • Dianwei Assimar transforms into a large axe form.

description.ja: • 賈詡アシュタロンは、暗殺者形態、魔蠍形態、武将形態の3形態に変形可能。
description.en: • Jia Xu Ashtalon can transform into three forms: assassin form, scorpion form, and warlord form.

description.ja: • 攻城兵器は、4形態変形し、投石発射ギミックを搭載。
description.en: • The siege weapon has four different forms and is equipped with a stone-throwing gimmick.

description.ja: • 曹操軍部隊兵が2体付属。
description.en: • Two Cao Cao army soldiers are included.

description.ja: 成形品×12、シール×1、輪ゴム×1、取説マンガ有り
description.en: Molded product x 12, Seal x 1, Rubber band x 1, Instruction manual included
